notes_for_editor: Generic name ('lookout tower') and no town, county, state or owner on the map. The OSM tag is observation, not fire lookout, so this may not belong in the lookout set. The brief's Texas placement and coordinates (33.03 N, 97.08 W) are not confirmed by any page read; the OSM page names no state, so the story no longer says the outline is in Texas. A WebSearch hit for a 150-ft Grapevine Main Observation Tower in downtown Grapevine was a search snippet only, not read in full; it does not appear to be this record, but that is not verified. Used 2 WebSearch calls; page reads: OSM way (twice), FFLA list, NHLR list. Suggested check: the OSM way's location on the map, or a county record, before keeping it in the set.
